other_failure_modes.name: Imputing test data using test statistics
other_failure_modes.description: The agent imputes missing values in the test set using statistics calculated from the test set itself rather than statistics learned from the training set. This violates the assumption that test data is independent and unseen, and causes failures during real-world inference when large test batches aren't available.

summary: The agent implements a standard regression pipeline using an ensemble of gradient boosting models, but introduces multiple forms of data leakage. Specifically, it leaks validation data into training via pre-split imputation, peeks at the test data to fit categorical encoders, and critically relies on test set statistics to impute missing values in the test set. Furthermore, the pipeline is overly simplistic, lacking any feature engineering or cross-validation.
